name: BEND FLY SHOP
address: 50 SE SCOTT STREET STE # 1, BEND, OR 97702

fr.elements: Main Building; Secondary Building; Outdoor Storage Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Internal Drive Aisle; Loading Area; Material Storage Area; Landscaped Area; Service Area; Open Area
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Outdoor Storage; Material Storage; Multiple Structures
fr.recommendations:
Based on the aerial observations provided, the following responder-safety recommendations are offered:

• Mark each access point with a visible address identifier so responders can confirm which entrance they are using when approaching from different directions.

• Mark the primary entrance distinctly from secondary access points to reduce approach confusion during emergency response.

• Keep the internal drive aisle clear of parked vehicles and stored materials to allow emergency vehicles to move between structures without obstruction.

• Keep the loading area clear of staged materials and equipment to preserve it as an emergency vehicle staging area.

• Mark the path from each access point to the secondary building so responders can locate it quickly without prior site familiarity.

• Post a site map at the primary access point showing the locations of both structures, the loading area, storage areas, and drive aisle routes.

• Keep a clear travel path between the main building and secondary building free of stored materials or equipment.

• Mark the outdoor storage area boundaries so responders can quickly identify where stored materials begin and end relative to the buildings.

• Keep material storage positioned away from building walls and doorways to preserve access around all sides of both structures.

• Mark the service area entrance with signage distinguishing it from the primary building entrance.

wildfire.conditions: Large Paved Area; Open Paved Area; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Building; Grass Cover; Open Terrain; Limited Rear Access; Woody Debris; Building Cluster; Scattered Shrubs
wildfire.recommendations:
• Remove woody debris visible near the building cluster.
• Trim shrubs and grass growing directly against building exteriors.
• Thin scattered shrubs between buildings to keep movement paths clear around the structures.
• Clear any grass and low vegetation that has grown into the paved areas along the building perimeter.
• Keep the rear of the buildings accessible by removing vegetation or debris that restricts movement in that area.
• Trim lower tree branches that hang over or near building rooflines and walls.
